title: "The Devil Doesn’t Always Come With a Pitchfork – He Comes Disguised as Truth" 🔥
paragraphs:
"The Devil Doesn’t Always Come With a Pitchfork – He Comes Disguised as Truth" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 Satan is not stupid. He knows that if he came to you looking like a red demon with horns and a pitchfork, you would immediately resist him.
🚨 Instead, he disguises himself as an angel of light.
📖 “And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.” (2 Corinthians 11:14)
💡 He works through deception, false teachings, and things that seem "good" but are actually leading people to destruction.
🙅‍♂️ Satan doesn’t just try to destroy the church from the outside—he infiltrates it from within.

🔥 1. Satan’s Greatest Weapon: Deception
📖 “The great dragon was hurled down—that ancient serpent called the devil, or Satan, who leads the whole world astray.” (Revelation 12:9)
🚨 Satan’s goal is not to make you worship him—his goal is to make you believe a lie.

He doesn’t need you to bow down to him. All he needs is for you to:
❌ Follow a false version of Jesus.
❌ Believe a twisted version of the Gospel.
❌ Trust emotions over the Word of God.
💡 Once he gets you to believe the wrong thing, you’re already in his trap.

🔥 2. The 5 Biggest Ways Satan Disguises Himself as "Truth"
1️⃣ False Teachings That Sound "Nice" But Are Spiritually Deadly
Satan’s lies often sound loving and harmless—but they are poison.
Many false preachers say things that feel good but contradict the Bible.
📖 “For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear.” (2 Timothy 4:3)
🚨 Truth: A message that makes you feel good but doesn’t align with the Bible is a lie.

2️⃣ "All Religions Lead to God"
The world says, “It doesn’t matter what you believe as long as you’re a good person.”
But Jesus was very clear—there is only ONE way to God.
📖 “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.” (John 14:6)
🚨 Truth: If Jesus is the only way, then every other way is a lie.

3️⃣ Miracles and Supernatural Signs That Lead People Away From God
Many assume if something is supernatural, it must be from God.
But Satan can also perform miracles to deceive people.
📖 “For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.” (Matthew 24:24)
🚨 Truth: Not every miracle is from God—test everything with Scripture.

4️⃣ Twisting the Bible to Justify Sin
Satan used Scripture to tempt Jesus in the wilderness—he knows the Bible too!
Many today misuse the Bible to justify sin and rebellion.
📖 “Even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.” (2 Corinthians 11:14)
🚨 Truth: Just because someone uses the Bible doesn’t mean they’re preaching truth—test their message.

5️⃣ Love Without Truth
The world preaches “love is love”—but true love corrects and saves people from destruction.
Many churches preach love while ignoring holiness and repentance.
📖 “Faithful are the wounds of a friend, but deceitful are the kisses of an enemy.” (Proverbs 27:6)
🚨 Truth: Real love tells the truth, even when it’s uncomfortable.

🔥 3. How to Protect Yourself From Satan’s Lies
1️⃣ Test Everything With the Word of God
📖 “Dear friends, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God.” (1 John 4:1)
🚨 Truth is not based on feelings—it’s based on God’s Word.

2️⃣ Stay Close to Jesus in Prayer
📖 “Pray without ceasing.” (1 Thessalonians 5:17)
🚨 A prayerless Christian is a powerless Christian.

3️⃣ Follow the Holy Spirit, Not Just Popular Opinion
📖 “But when He, the Spirit of truth, comes, He will guide you into all truth.” (John 16:13)
🚨 Just because something is trending doesn’t mean it’s from God.

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 20, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose truth over deception. I will test every teaching, stay close to Jesus, and reject Satan’s lies. I will not fall for the devil’s traps, no matter how ‘good’ they look."

🔥 THE “EXPOSE SATAN” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Identify and reject any lies you’ve believed.
✅ Step 3: Encourage 3 friends to grow in truth and study God’s Word.

🌌 SATAN IS A LIAR – DON’T FALL FOR HIS TRICKS 🌌
📖 “You shall know the truth, and the truth shall set you free.” (John 8:32)

👉 The only way to defeat Satan’s deception is to know the truth.
👉 Are you ready to expose the enemy and walk in victory?

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 20, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Give me discernment to recognize the devil’s lies. Help me to stay close to Your Word and not be deceived by things that look good but lead away from You. Fill me with wisdom, strength, and boldness to expose the enemy’s tactics and walk in Your truth every day.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
